summary: Iloilo 2nd District representative with 55 principal-authored bills. Authored the national minimum wage, exclusion of overtime pay from taxable income, additional income tax exemption bonuses, an anti-dynasty ban and a definition of technology-facilitated violence against women.
caveat: Anti-dynasty and gender bills are single issues and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored the national minimum wage (-2) and worker-side tax relief through an overtime pay exclusion and higher exemption bonuses (-1). Two issues.
